required_claim_limits: Call the 54-hour brain-dead-human kidney observation short-term feasibility only.
Call nonhuman-primate heart survival preclinical evidence only.
Do not claim xenotransplantation has solved organ shortage.
Do not state that rejection, coagulation dysfunction, or infection risk has been eliminated.
Do not report expected scenario outcomes as observed findings.
Do not include acknowledgments, author names, affiliations, funding text, or fictitious institutions.
